groups.name: The Great Lakes
groups.fact: Together the Great Lakes hold roughly a fifth of the world's surface fresh water.

groups.name: Northern Italian lakes
groups.fact: Lake Garda is the largest lake in Italy.

groups.name: Lakes that are called seas
groups.fact: The Aral Sea has lost most of its water since the 1960s, because the rivers feeding it were diverted for irrigation.

groups.name: Lakes in Africa's Rift Valley
groups.fact: Lake Tanganyika is the longest freshwater lake in the world, and the second deepest after Baikal.
